title: RoskoInf script (Close Project)
features:
Player Functions:
- Increased Speed: Accelerate your character for fast movement throughout the game world.
- Flight (Left Mouse Button): Utilize the flight function to move freely in the air.
- Auto Item Collection: Automatically collect all items without manual interaction.
- No Fall Damage: No need to worry about damage from falling.
- Unlimited Stamina: Your character never gets tired, allowing for extended play sessions.

ESP (Extra Sensory Perception) Features:
- ESP: See players and objects through walls and other obstacles.
- ESP Color Customization: Choose a highlight color for easier differentiation of objects and players.

Boat Features:
- Random Boat Spawn: Receive a random boat for your adventures.
- Boat Teleport to Island 4: Move your boat to the specified island effortlessly.

Teleportation Features:
- Teleport to Player: Quickly move to other players on the map.
- Teleport to Titan Boss: Instantly arrive at the powerful Titan boss.
- Teleport to Kraken: Teleport to the mighty Kraken for thrilling battles.
